title: Verifiable compliance evidence for high-risk AI under the EU AI Act: code, evidence ledgers and experiment protocols
description:
A compliance-as-code architecture that turns EU AI Act obligations for high-risk AI systems into third-party-verifiable evidence records: a Compliance Policy Engine with fail-closed validation, Ed25519-signed and hash-chained records (RFC 8785 canonical form), OSCAL 1.1.2 assessment results with selective disclosure, and per-record or batched anchoring on Hyperledger Fabric.

The archive holds the code, the evidence ledgers and exports of every run, the pre-registered experiment protocols, the result files of the cost ablation, the Fabric anchoring measurements, the tamper experiment and the audit-question matrix, and the scripts that draw the article's figures. The dissertation's version of the code is the tag thesis-v1.0.
